verdict.rationale: Mastra explicitly documents self-hosting as a free, Apache 2.0-licensed option ("Build and host agents anywhere"), and deployment docs confirm it runs on standard Node.js/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare environments outside any vendor SaaS. The community licensing debate (mastra-comm-2) concerns reselling Mastra as a hosted service under a different license note, not the core self-host-for-own-use capability, so it doesn't contradict this story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment in production.
